metadata.description: Official OmniMCP Gateway v6.8.5 plugin marketplace offering Standard (local stdio) and Enterprise (governed remote Streamable HTTP + OIDC/RBAC + Tool Group isolation) plugins.

plugins.name: omni-mcp
plugins.description: Standard local/dev OmniMCP Gateway over stdio via npx @rangow2260/omni-mcp --stdio with all 4 bundled agent skills.

plugins.name: omni-mcp-enterprise
plugins.description: Enterprise governed OmniMCP plugin using remote Streamable HTTP (/omni/mcp or /groups/<slug>/mcp), Bearer/OIDC auth, Tool Group isolation, and enterprise-policy.json.
